# Acme dataset — provenance & artifacts

## Provenance statement

**Fully synthetic.** Every byte in this directory is generated by
`generate.py` from a fixed seed using only the Python standard library and
numpy. No external datasets, no scraped text, no third-party embeddings, no
license encumbrances. **Safe to redistribute** with the course.

* Generator: `labs/data/generate.py` (deterministic; gzip mtime pinned to 0,
  so reruns are **byte-identical**)
* Seed: **20260713** (recorded in `manifest.json`)
* Generated and verified in the build sandbox on 2026-07-13 with numpy 2.4.4,
  Python 3.11 — regeneration on 3.12 must be hash-checked once the lab venv
  exists (`pytest tests/test_data_determinism.py`).

## What's in it

50,000 Acme Retail objects (85% products, 15% support docs) across 32
categories and 40 fictional brands, assigned to **24 named tenants**
(`tenant-000` … `tenant-023`) for the multi-tenant collection variant.
Vectors are a seeded Gaussian mixture with **one cluster center per
category**, so nearest-neighbor structure is meaningful (top-10 neighbors
share the query's category) while `brand` remains uncorrelated with vector
space — exactly what the Lab 2 filter-strategy drill needs.

| Artifact | Shape / contents | Bytes | sha256 |
|---|---|---:|---|
| `vectors.npy` | (50000, 256) float32, unit-normalized | 51,200,128 | `d701e2b53548f31e1a96b9aa441e5692154470c3a13254eac6215935366ef0be` |
| `queries.npy` | (200, 256) float32, unit-normalized, drawn near centers | 204,928 | `9166591c80e63cdda2ccac9280936c5dd356c8ade6c4626b093858e8ba2ddf2a` |
| `ground_truth.npy` | (200, 100) int32 — **EXACT** brute-force top-100 row ids (float64 matmul) | 80,128 | `48b3f41261eb6a5670e9f5dc024668b06e40db13736d36fde03dab80cd8505d2` |
| `objects.jsonl.gz` | 50,000 JSON lines (`vec_id`, `product_id`, `title`, `description`, `category`, `brand`, `price`, `tenant`, `doc_type`) | 2,332,975 | `d47db90d041caffe93fe92c3f235c3b1591cbeb1a18b78c85625ead5bf725eee` |
| `manifest.json` | parameters + per-artifact sha256 | — | (self-describing) |

Total ≈ **54 MB** (~51 MB of it vectors). Generation time measured at
**4.8–6.8 s** on a 2-vCPU sandbox. Ground truth verified two ways: an
independent in-process recompute on sampled queries, and full-scale
regeneration to a temp dir with byte-identical hashes.

Scale decision: the planned 50k × 256 target fit comfortably (seconds to
generate, <60 MB on disk), so **no downscaling to 30k was needed**.

## Regenerating

```bash
python3 generate.py            # writes into this directory, ~5s
python3 generate.py --help     # --count/--dim/--seed/... for experiments
```

Regenerating with default parameters must reproduce the hashes above; the
unit test `tests/test_data_determinism.py::test_full_scale_manifest_hashes_recorded`
enforces this. If you change `generate.py` behavior on purpose, update the
hashes there **and** in this table, and re-run `make smoke`.

## Scale caveat (say this in every debrief)

50k × 256-dim is a *teaching* dataset. Acme's fictional production
profile is 40M × 768-dim. Recall/latency deltas measured here demonstrate
mechanisms and methodology; absolute numbers do not transfer. Lab 2's
report template forces this caveat into every recommendation.
